svg.title: 06 · Three-Tier Privacy Gate, Bulk Visibility & Shared Collection Access Matrix
svg.desc: iqoqo v1.2.0 access control diagram showing private, friends_only, and public item states, 4 management paths including physical_location redaction, bulk visibility/location fan-out, FederationConsent pruning, and the SharedCollection evaluation matrix with Friend Bonus.
svg.text: 06 · Three-Tier Privacy Gate, Bulk Visibility & Shared Collection Access Matrix
iqoqo v1.2.0 — Visibility State Model, Owner-Gated Physical Location, Bulk Ops, Federation Consent & Share Matrix

g.text: default SPARQL snapshots & public RSS feeds.
• Unlocked on public_only links via Friend Bonus.
• Sets visibility & structured physical_location (+ loc: promotion)
Sidebar Visibility & Physical Location (?location=..., location_counts) facets; BulkItemVisibilityToolbar sends:
PATCH /api/items/bulk-visibility | PATCH /api/items/bulk-location (1..100 items, FEDERATION_HEAD_MODE guard, 403 non-owner)
FederationConsent (federated_collection=False) prunes owner's items from public graph builds & federated exposure unless viewer is an accepted friend.
+ full edit UI on own shelf
Redaction & Headers: Always strips owner prices, physical_location & private reading_sessions notes • Private Cache-Control + Vary: Authorization, Cookie
